how_to_apply: Visit the official BPSC recruitment website at bpsconline.bihar.gov.in.
Open the One Time Registration (OTR) section.
Complete OTR if you are applying through the new recruitment portal for the first time.
Existing registered candidates can log in using their credentials.
Complete the DigiLocker account connection and consent process, where applicable.
Enter personal details, contact information and permanent address.
Provide educational qualification details.
Enter experience information where applicable.
Upload the required photograph and signatures.
Check and lock the completed candidate profile.
Open the Active Advertisements section.
Select the eligible advertisement between 17/2026 and 21/2026.
Review the post-specific eligibility and reservation requirements.
Open the application form for the selected advertisement.
Enter the required category and qualification information.
Review the submitted details before payment.

content_sections.heading: BPSC Agriculture Department Vacancy 2026 - 147 Posts
content_sections.text: The Agriculture Department has announced 147 vacancies across five Assistant Director specializations. Reservation Note: The above table shows the main vertical reservation categories. The official vacancy schedule separately identifies posts reserved for women within the respective categories, the BC women category where applicable, and horizontal reservation for eligible descendants of freedom fighters and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. Candidates must refer to the detailed reservation matrix in the notification before selecting a category.

content_sections.heading: BPSC Agriculture Department Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications vary according to the selected Assistant Director specialization. Candidates must possess the prescribed degree from a recognized university or institution. Candidates who hold the prescribed Bachelor's Degree in Agricultural Engineering from a recognized Agricultural University, institution or Central University can apply for the 50 Assistant Director (Agricultural Engineering) vacancies. Candidates must possess the prescribed Bachelor's qualification in Statistics, Mathematics or Agricultural Statistics in Agricultural Science from an accepted institution. Engineering graduates may be eligible for the Measurement and Weights specialization, depending on their degree and recognition. Agricultural Engineering graduates can apply for the Agricultural Engineering specialization if they meet its specific qualification conditions.

content_sections.heading: BPSC Agriculture Department Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a written examination and interview, with additional weightage for relevant service experience wherever prescribed. Online application and eligibility verification. Written examination. Shortlisting based on examination performance. Interview. Assessment of eligible experience weightage. Preparation of the final merit list. Verification of original documents. Final recommendation for appointment. The written examination and interview marks will be assessed according to the formula prescribed by BPSC. Eligible candidates with qualifying previous service experience may receive additional weightage.

content_sections.heading: BPSC Agriculture Department Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination includes General Hindi, General Knowledge and Agriculture Service specialization papers. The exact subject papers depend on the selected Assistant Director post. General Hindi: This is a qualifying paper. Candidates must obtain at least 30 marks out of 100. Marks in General Hindi are not counted towards the final merit list. Specialization Papers: Questions will be based on the syllabus for the relevant Agricultural Engineering, Statistics, Measurement and Weights, Chemistry or Plant Protection specialization. All written papers are objective-type, consisting of multiple-choice questions. These qualifying percentages apply according to the category conditions in the notification. Candidates must also secure the required marks in General Hindi.

content_sections.heading: BPSC Agriculture Department Interview 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted through the written examination will be called for an interview carrying 50 marks . BPSC will prepare the final merit list using the prescribed written examination weightage, interview performance and eligible experience marks. The interview schedule will be published separately on the official website.

content_sections.heading: BPSC Agriculture Department Experience Weightage 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides additional weightage for eligible candidates who possess relevant experience in an equivalent post under the Bihar Government. Experience marks are awarded at the prescribed rate of five marks per completed qualifying year, subject to a maximum of 25 marks . For the Measurement and Weights specialization, the notification specifically refers to experience obtained before 26 November 2026 under the prescribed conditions. Candidates claiming experience weightage must produce certificates issued by the competent authority, with the required service period and salary/payment details.

content_sections.heading: BPSC Agriculture Department Recruitment 2026 Reservation
content_sections.text: The notification includes provisions for: Scheduled Caste candidates. Scheduled Tribe candidates. Extremely Backward Class candidates. Backward Class candidates. Backward Class women, where applicable. Economically Weaker Section candidates. Eligible women candidates under horizontal reservation. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. Eligible grandchildren of freedom fighters. Other specifically notified reservation categories. Important: Bihar reservation benefits are subject to the State's prescribed domicile and certificate requirements. Candidates claiming reserved-category benefits must possess valid certificates issued in the prescribed format.

content_sections.heading: BPSC Agriculture Department Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official BPSC online application portal. Apply Online: bpsconline.bihar.gov.in Application Starts: 15 December 2026. Fee Payment Last Date: 11 January 2027. Final Application Last Date: 12 January 2027. Applications submitted through offline modes will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for BPSC Agriculture Department Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Fee payment alone does not complete the recruitment application. Candidates must submit the final application form after successful payment.

content_sections.heading: BPSC Agriculture Department Recruitment 2026 Photo and Signature Requirements
content_sections.text: The official notification requires applicants to upload a live photograph and signatures according to the prescribed application portal instructions. Upload a clear live photograph through the supported webcam process. Upload the required Hindi signature. Upload the required English signature. Follow the prescribed image dimensions and file requirements. Review the uploaded files before locking the profile. Candidates should ensure that their photograph and signatures are readable and match their personal identification details.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BPSC Agriculture Department Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready for online application and subsequent verification: Class 10 certificate or marksheet showing date of birth. Relevant Bachelor's Degree certificate. Final-year or semester marksheets, where applicable. Educational qualification certificates supporting the chosen specialization. Valid reservation category certificate, where applicable. Bihar domicile or permanent residence certificate for reservation claims. Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where required. EWS certificate, where applicable. Disability certificate, where applicable. Freedom fighter descendant certificate, where applicable. Relevant Government service and experience certificates for experience weightage. No Objection Certificate for eligible Government employees, where required. Valid identity proof. Recent photograph and signatures. Final submitted online application form. Examination fee payment confirmation. Original documents and supporting certificates must be produced when required by the Commission.
